Key equipment

Complete crews' kit, ready to mobilise

For each trade we own the full set of equipment needed, so we never depend on rental to start a project.

Asphalt paving

  • 2 XCMG pavers, RP705 and RP355
  • Screed width from 0.50 to 7.50 m
  • 5 tandem and 12 t rollers
  • 2,000 L emulsion sprayer

Milling

  • 2 XCMG milling machines, XM1505F and XM1005F
  • 1.00 m and 1.50 m milling width
  • Skid steer with 0.60 m planer for patching
  • Night work

Special foundations

  • Comacchio MC8 HT and XCMG XLS4 200B rigs
  • 2 Marini EP120 drilling units
  • Automated grouting plant
  • 2 shotcrete units, compressors up to 24 m³

Fleet organisation

A fleet that is tracked, maintained and available

Yards in Petit-Bourg

Two yards in Colin, in central Guadeloupe, to store equipment and prepare sites.

In-house maintenance

Our teams handle routine maintenance and equipment follow-up to limit downtime.

XCMG partner

A fleet largely made up of XCMG machines, with direct access to the manufacturer and spare parts in the Caribbean.

Inter-island mobilisation

Equipment is deployed in Guadeloupe and in Saint-Martin, where we carry out our paving projects.
